construct_optimizer: build a torch SGD, Adam, or AdamW optimizer from a model and config with parameter grouping
get_param_groups: build parameter groups separating batch norm, non batch norm, and zero weight decay params from a model
get_ld_param_groups: build parameter groups with layer decay multipliers for each layer of a transformer model
get_epoch_lr: retrieve the learning rate for a given training epoch based on the lr policy config
set_lr: set the learning rate across all optimizer parameter groups while respecting layer decay multipliers
